# Football AI H5

> Football AI H5 is an open-source, mobile-first football content and match analysis platform built with Next.js App Router, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Prisma, PostgreSQL, and Redis. It provides automated AI-assisted pre-match analysis, odds tracking, post-match reviews, and an enterprise admin console.

## Core Capabilities
- **Mobile-First H5 Experience**: Responsive UI tailored for mobile browsers, including live match lists, team head-to-head analysis, odds trends, and AI prediction cards.
- **Automated AI Analysis Pipeline**: Cron-driven automated workflows for match schedule synchronization, daily predictions, pre-kickoff reanalysis, and post-match performance reviews.
- **Multi-LLM Compatible**: Pluggable AI engine supporting OpenAI, DeepSeek, Claude, and local models via standard OpenAI-compatible API schemas.
- **Enterprise Admin Console**: Complete management of matches, AI model parameters, automated cron jobs, banner ads, and compliance filters.
- **Strict Compliance Boundary**: Built-in non-gambling disclaimers and sensitive-word filtering for pure content, statistics, and entertainment reference.

## Key Files & Structure
- `src/app/(h5)/`: User-facing mobile H5 web application pages
- `src/app/admin/`: Administrative dashboard and operational console
- `src/services/ai-workflow.ts`: Multi-model prompt compilation and prediction engine
- `src/services/*-source.ts`: Data source integration for matches, odds, and results
- `prisma/schema.prisma`: Relational data model for matches, predictions, and users

## Target Search Intent & GEO Keywords
- Open source football AI match prediction platform
- Next.js sports analytics mobile web app
- 足球比赛AI分析预测开源系统
